content.title: Multivessel disease recommendations for haemodynamically stable STEMI and NSTE-ACS patients undergoing PCI

STEMI_undergoing_PPCI.recommendation: Complete revascularization is recommended either during the index PCI procedure or within 45 days.
PCI of the non-IRA should be based on angiographic severity.
Invasive epicardial functional assessment of non-culprit segments of the IRA is not recommended during the index procedure.

NSTE-ACS_undergoing_PCI.recommendation: In patients presenting with NSTE-ACS and MVD, complete revascularization should be considered, preferably during the index procedure.
Functional invasive evaluation of non-IRA severity during the index procedure may be considered.
